S. B. RE...TRY

ASSASSINATION OF LIU LI-AU ON FOOCHOW ROAD

At 2.30 p.m. yesterday an assassination
took place in the King Hwa Restaurant (京華酒家) at 221
Foochow Road.
Liu Li-au (劉理澳) alias Liu Ts'an-pee
(劉燦波), age 36, native of Yokio, a naturalised
Japanese subject, was Chief of the Playwright and Directors
Section of the Central Studio of the National Government in
Nanking before the hostilities. He was the author of the
scenario of the film "Scarlet Lilian" (化身姑娘) produced
by the Shanghai Yi Hwa Motion Picture Company (藝華影片公司).
After the outbreak of hostilities, he, in partnership with a
Japanese, K. Matsuzaki, operated the China Motion Picture
Company (中華影業公司) which helps the Japanese to control
the motion picture business in the fallen areas, and he was
also under-chief of the manufacturing department of the
company. Later he became general manager of the "Kuo Min
Daily News."

At about 1 p.m. yesterday Liu Li-au,
dressed in a blue flannel foreign coat, white serge trousers
and white leather shoes, went together with about 12 Chinese
and Japanese friends to the King Hwa Restaurant for tiffin.
At 2.30 p.m., the tiffin being over, as Liu and his friends
were descending the stairs, he was shot at by a man in the
dining room below. Two of the three shots struck Liu in the
right breast. Liu fell down the stairs and lay on the floor
with blood flowing out from his wounds. K. Matsuzaki, chief
of the manufacturing department of the China Motion Picture
Company, was slightly wounded. The gunman then hurriedly
ran out of the restaurant and boarded motor car licence
No.4632 which quickly drove off.

Hearing the shooting, several patrolling
policemen hurried to the scene and at once made a search.
Two men in grey woollen long gowns came out of the restaurant
acting in a suspicious manner and were arrested by the Police.
Liu was then driven off by his Japanese friend in private car
licence No.4402 to the Lester Chinese Hospital, but on arrival
there he was pronounced dead. K. Matsuzaki's wound was given
a dressing and he was allowed to leave the hospital.

The Police are conducting an investigation
into the case. The restaurant boys were taken to the Station
for interrogation. The Japanese are also making close
enquiries about this case and have taken photographs and
measurements of the scene. It is learned that the Police
are endeavouring to ascertain the motive of the assassination.
An hour later the motor car licence No.4632 was found in the
Louza district and taken into the custody of the Police.

One witness told a reporter that the gunman
was about 30 years of age, dressed in a foreign suit. He had
been eating in the dining room downstairs for about one hour.
When he heard somebody descending, he rushed to the side of
the stairs and producing his pistol fired three shots at Liu.
After that he went out of the restaurant and drove off in a
car. It was not known whether there was another man in the
car.

Shun Pao :-

In Shanghai, Liu was well known in
local motion picture circles. It was said that Liu had
sent to Japan the film "Jasmine" (茉莉花女), the exportation
of which had at one time caused a severe dispute in Shanghai.

福州路刘理澳遇刺案

昨日下午二时三十分，福州路221号京华酒家发生一起暗杀事件。
刘理澳（劉理澳），别名刘灿波（劉燦波），36岁，籍贯横滨（Yokio，音译），归化日本籍。战事爆发前，曾任南京国民政府中央电影制片厂编剧导演科科长。他是上海艺华影片公司出品的电影《化身姑娘》的剧本作者。战事爆发后，他与日本人松崎（K. Matsuzaki，音译）合伙经营中华影业公司，协助日本人控制沦陷区的电影业务，并担任该公司制作部副部长。后来，他成为《国民日报》总经理。

昨日下午一时左右，刘理澳身穿蓝色法兰绒西装外套、白色哔叽长裤和白色皮鞋，与约十二名中日朋友一同前往京华酒家用午餐。下午二时三十分，午餐结束后，当刘及其朋友走下楼梯时，被楼下餐厅内的一名男子开枪射击。三发子弹中有两发击中刘的右胸。刘滚落楼梯，倒在地板上，伤口流血不止。中华影业公司制作部部长松崎受轻伤。枪手随后匆忙跑出餐厅，登上牌照号为4632的汽车迅速驶离。

听到枪声后，几名巡逻警察迅速赶到现场并立即展开搜查。两名身穿灰色羊毛长衫的男子神色可疑地走出餐厅，被警方逮捕。刘随后由其日本友人乘坐私家车牌号4402的汽车送往莱斯德华人医院（Lester Chinese Hospital），但抵达后即被宣告死亡。松崎的伤口经过包扎后获准离开医院。

警方正在对此案进行调查。酒楼侍者已被带往警署接受讯问。日方也在密切查问此案，并对现场进行了拍照和测量。据悉，警方正努力查明暗杀的动机。一小时后，牌照号为4632的汽车在罗素界（Louza district，音译，即老闸捕房辖区）被发现，并由警方扣押。

一名目击者告诉记者，枪手年龄约30岁，身穿西装。他在楼下餐厅用餐约一小时。当他听到有人下楼时，冲到楼梯旁，掏出手枪向刘开了三枪。随后他走出餐厅，驾车离去。车内是否还有其他人尚不清楚。

《申报》：-

刘在上海本地电影界颇有名气。据说刘曾将电影《茉莉花女》运往日本，该片的出口曾在上海引起严重纠纷。

September 4, 1940

TAIRIKU SHIMPO

"CAREER OF THE LATE MR. LIU HAN-HA, A VICTIM OF TERRORISM"

The remains of the late Mr. Liu Han-ha of the Central China Moving Picture Company, the central figure in the establishment of a new culture in East Asia, who has been assassinated by anti-Japanese terrorists, were removed to the International Funeral Directors from the Lester Chinese Hospital at 5 p.m. on August 3 by Messrs Ishikawa, Matsuzaki and others.

Following his graduation from the Aoyama Gakuin Institute in Tokyo, Mr. Liu came to Shanghai and studied literature in Fu Tan University. In 1931, he operated a book store known as Su Mou (水沫) on Foochow Road and also published a magazine entitled "New Literature". He published some novels and wrote comments on the moving pictures etc. under the pen name of Liu Li-au (刘丽鸥). Later he formed the Shanghai Yi Hwa Motion Picture Company (上海艺华影片公司) and afterwards went over to the Central Cinema Studio. During this period he produced pictures for the promotion of Sino-Japanese friendship under the anti-Japanese government directed by General Chiang and created sensation when his films were exhibited so much so that sometimes he was called a traitor.

Following the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities he came to Shanghai from Nanking and co-operated with Mr. Kawakita, managing director of the Central China Moving Picture Company, of which he became the Vice Chief of the production department and maintained close contact with persons connected with film production in the Settlement. He was a virtual leader of the Chinese cinema companies, such as the Shin Hwa and Hwa Hwa. He produced cultural pictures and in addition endeavoured to educate Chinese in cinema mechanics. Mr. Liu was the only Japanese working in Chinese cinema circles. He persuaded anti-Japanese Chinese authors and persons connected with the cinema to co-operate with Japanese in establishing peace and a new China.

He stressed that sino-Japanese co-operation was the ideal of all Japanese and emphasized this idea in his pictures and writings. He was condemned as a traitor.

Following the death of Mr. Moh Shih-ying (穆时英), president of the "Kuo Min Daily News", he observed the wish of Mr. Moh and became President of this newspaper under a policy of peace and national reconstruction.

P.T.O.

1940年9月4日

《大陆新报》

“恐怖主义受害者刘汉哈先生生平”

华中电影公司刘汉哈先生遗体于8月3日下午5时由石川（Ishikawa，音译）、松崎等人从莱斯德华人医院移至国际殡仪馆。刘汉哈先生是东亚新文化建设的核心人物，遭抗日恐怖分子暗杀身亡。

刘先生在东京青山学院毕业后来到上海，在复旦大学攻读文学。1931年，他在福州路经营一家名为“水沫”的书店，并出版名为《新文学》的杂志。他以刘丽鸥（Liu Li-au）为笔名发表了一些小说，并撰写电影评论等文章。后来他组建了上海艺华影片公司，随后转入中央电影制片厂。在此期间，他制作了旨在促进中日友好的影片，以对抗蒋介石将军领导的抗日政府，其影片上映时引起轰动，以至于他有时被称为汉奸。

中日战事爆发后，他从南京来到上海，与华中电影公司总经理川喜多（Kawakita，音译）先生合作，担任该公司制作部副部长，并与租界内从事电影制作的人士保持密切联系。他是新华、华华等中国电影公司的实际领导者。他制作文化影片，此外还致力于向中国人在电影机械技术方面提供教育。刘先生是在中国电影界工作的唯一日本人。他劝说反日的中国作家和电影界人士与日本人合作，建立和平与新中华。

他强调中日合作是所有日本人的理想，并在其影片和文章中强调这一观点。他被谴责为汉奸。

继《国民日报》社长穆时英先生去世后，他遵循穆先生的遗愿，本着和平与国家重建的政策，出任该报社长。

pages.en:
September 4, 1940.
Morning Translation

Within the short space of a little over
two months, two misfortunes have befallen this paper. The
assassination of our two close friends one after the
other has caused us great grief. From the viewpoint
of private friendship, we have lost two respected friends
and in the matter of the propagation of peace we have lost
two staunch comrades. The deep sorrow in our heart is
beyond description.
Mr. Liu succeeded Mr. Moh Shih-ying
(穆時英) as general manager of this paper following
Mr. Moh's assassination; Mr. Liu was one of Mr. Moh's
intimate friends and in order to manifest his close
friendship Mr. Liu courageously accepted the post of
general manager of this paper so as to carry on the
posthumous wishes of the late Mr. Moh. He had also
earnestly given us to understand that his principal object
in accepting this important post was to carry on in the
spirit and according to the posthumous wishes of the late
Mr. Moh for the welfare of this paper. He encouraged us
to exert our efforts in the propagation of peace so as to
appease the spirit of the late Mr. Moh.
During the past few days Mr. Liu often
held conferences with us and the main topic at these
conferences was how to make our paper become the ideal
newspaper. While his words are still ringing in our
ears, Mr. Liu has departed from us for ever.
Our mind has been so shocked that we
have no time to manifest our heartfelt sorrow. We must
strengthen our will and attack our enemy. We should not
allow this villainous assassination have any effect
upon our courage in our work to promote the peace movement.
We pledge to take up blood in a desperate struggle
against the dictators and to fight for righteousness and
for peace which is so fervently desired by the people
throughout the country. Let our enemy harken to these
words!

Central China Daily News (editorial):
The Succession Of Assassination
It was not so long ago that Chen Keh-liang
(陳可良), a chief engineer of the Ministry of
Communications, was assassinated and Huang Ba-ching
(黃寶慶), a detective chief of the Police Bureau,
succumbed to his injuries. Yesterday Mr. Liu Li-an, general
manager of the Kuo Wen Daily News, died at the hands of
assassins.
When the Settlement authorities
are anxious about the maintenance of peace and good order
in the Foreign Settlements and have requested China and
Japan for assistance or co-operation, cases of assassination
are frequently taking place in the Settlements, the
authorities of which do not seem to know how to prevent
these crimes. It makes one suspect whether the Settlement
authorities are really sincere for the maintenance of peace
and good order.

P. T. O.
pages.zh:
1940年9月4日。
晨间译文

在短短两个多月的时间里，本报遭遇了两次不幸。两位挚友相继遇刺，令我们悲痛万分。从私人友谊的角度来看，我们失去了两位受人尊敬的朋友；在和平宣传事业中，我们失去了两位坚定的同志。心中的深切悲痛难以言表。
刘先生在穆时英先生遇刺后接任本报总经理；刘先生是穆先生的密友之一，为了彰显其深厚友谊，刘先生勇敢接受了本报总经理一职，以继承已故穆先生的遗愿。他还诚恳地向我们表示，他接受这一重要职务的主要目的是本着已故穆先生的精神和遗愿，为了本报的利益而工作。他鼓励我们努力进行和平宣传，以慰藉已故穆先生的在天之灵。
在过去几天里，刘先生经常与我们召开会议，会议的主要议题是如何使本报成为理想的报纸。言犹在耳，刘先生却已永远离开了我们。
我们的精神受到如此震撼，以至于无暇表达内心的悲痛。我们必须坚定意志，攻击敌人。我们不应让这卑鄙的暗杀行为影响我们在促进和平运动工作中的勇气。我们誓言以鲜血与独裁者进行殊死斗争，为全国人民热切渴望的正义与和平而战。让我们的敌人听听这些话！

《华中日报》（社论）：
暗杀接连发生
不久前，交通部总工程师陈可良遇刺，警察局侦探长黄宝庆伤重不治。昨日，《国闻日报》总经理刘理安死于刺客之手。
当租界当局急于维持公共租界的和平与秩序，并请求中日协助或合作时，租界内却频繁发生暗杀案件，而租界当局似乎不知如何预防这些罪行。这让人怀疑租界当局是否真的诚心维护和平与秩序。

September 4, 1940. Morning Translation

An urgent problem in the protection of
peace and good order in East Asia is the readjustment of the
status quo in the South Pacific; and another urgent
problem in the peace movement is the settlement of the
Foreign Settlements question in Shanghai. During the
present period of transition, if the Settlement
authorities are sincere for peace and good order, they
should recognize the actualities of the situation and
acknowledge that Shanghai cannot exist separated from the
Government. With regard to this point, Li Shih-chung
(李士群), Vice-Minister of Police, held an
important conference a week ago at which he revealed
China's determination. He later requested the
Settlement authorities to give its reasonable consideration
to this problem.
We believe that if the Foreign Settlements
are placed under the direct administration of the Chinese
Government, such unfortunate cases would not happen.
If the Settlement authorities know how to co-operate with
the Chinese Government during the present very difficult
situation, they would be taking a wise step for they
would be saving themselves. The Powers are efficiently
maintaining peace and order in their own cities, yet in
the Foreign Settlements they are encountering numerous
insurmountable difficulties. What is the cause? It is
because the territory of the Foreign Settlements is
Chinese territory and as such it should only be administered
by the Chinese Government. Wherever a foreign settlement
may exist, the administrative power of the Chinese Government
over the settlement cannot be ignored. Should the
Settlement authorities still fail to come to their senses and
remain aloof from the Nanking Government, which has been
reformed and has returned to the Capital, then it will be
similar to suspending Foreign Settlements in the air
while their foundations will be shaken.
The maintenance of peace and good order
in the Foreign Settlements has deteriorated to such an
extent that people are being killed in town in daylight
while the cases of snatching and robbery can be "heaped
up high as a hill". When cases of snatching and robbery
can be "heaped up high as a hill", the lawful livelihood
of the entire body of residents will be menaced and the
peace and good order in the Foreign Settlements will suffer
a general collapse. The Settlement authorities should
realize that the Chinese Government cannot sit down calmly
and allow the situation to deteriorate any further. Urged
by its duty, the Chinese Government will be forced to take
effective steps to remedy the situation.
Within two months, President Moh (莫)
and President Liu of the "Kuo Min Daily News" have lost
their lives to the country. President Liu's connection
with the "Kuo Min Daily News" was not a long one, but he
left behind a very good record. His death is deeply
regretted.
pages.zh:
1940年9月4日。晨间译文

维护东亚和平与良序的一个紧迫问题，是重新调整南太平洋的现状；而和平运动中的另一个紧迫问题，则是解决上海公共租界问题。在目前的过渡时期，如果租界当局真心希望实现和平与良序，就应当认清现实情况，承认上海无法脱离政府而独立存在。关于这一点，警政部副部长李士群于一周前举行了一次重要会议，会上阐明了中国的决心。他随后要求租界当局对这一问题给予合理考虑。

我们相信，如果将公共租界置于中国政府的直接管辖之下，此类不幸事件便不会发生。如果租界当局懂得在当前极其困难的局势下与中国政府合作，那将是明智之举，因为这等于是在自救。列强在其本国城市中有效地维持着和平与秩序，然而在公共租界内，他们却面临着无数难以克服的困难。原因何在？这是因为公共租界的领土是中国领土，因此理应仅由中国政府进行管理。无论外国租界存在于何处，中国政府对该租界的行政权力都不容忽视。如果租界当局仍不醒悟，继续疏远已经改组并还都南京的国民政府，那就如同将公共租界悬于空中，而其根基却在动摇。

公共租界内和平与良序的维持状况已恶化到如此地步：光天化日之下，市内发生杀人案件，而抢夺和抢劫案件更是“堆积如山”。当抢夺和抢劫案件“堆积如山”时，全体居民的生计将受到威胁，公共租界的和平与良序也将面临全面崩溃。租界当局应当认识到，中国政府不能坐视局势进一步恶化。出于职责所迫，中国政府将被迫采取有效措施来补救这一局面。

在两个月内，《国民日报》社长莫先生和刘社长为国捐躯。刘社长与《国民日报》的关系虽不长，但他留下了非常好的业绩记录。他的逝世令人深感痛惜。

Chinese-American Daily News, Sin Wan Pao, National Herald
and Shun Pao :-

KIDNAPPING IN WESTERN DISTRICT.

At about 7 a.m. yesterday, a young man
who was passing near Ching Sze Tu Temple (金司徒廟) on
Connaught Road, out of limits, was seized by an armed
gang and placed in a private car/licence number of which
is unknown. It is not known in which direction the
car drove off.

《中美日报》、《新晚报》、《国家导报》及《申报》：

西区绑架案。

昨日早晨7时许，一名青年在界外康纳路（Connaught Road）金司徒庙附近经过时，被一伙武装歹徒劫持，并被塞进一辆私人汽车，车牌号码不详。该车驶往何方亦不清楚。
